title: First Mardi Gras playing alone in the street
summary: Reel 3. Masked with his sister's factory girls, he blew clarinet all day.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: I don't know if I'm a good man. What about Bush Hall? I want to get more about that band. Who was in that? Do you remember anything? No, I don't remember. I just used to see him nine dead. Another thing I wanted to ask you was, you were telling Russell about going out with Mardi Gras and playing alone in the streets just you on the clarinet when you were young? Well, that was the first time I went out with my home in the street. I got masked with my sister's waiting at her factory. They all was masked. All the girls were masked. There was about 20 of them. They asked me to mask with them. Twenty girls? Yeah. I had them to. I had my older sister. She could sew good. I had her to make me a suit, a lot of sack, brand new sacks. She made me a sack suit. And I took the clarinet and I was blowing that clarinet all day by myself. A couple of them had tambourines. Could you play good then? Well, I could play only melody, you know. It was good for the Mardi Gras. Yeah. Well, that was the first time I got on the street and played. And Margie had Jessica Amat. You see, Margie was brand new. So, well, I don't like to play with the melody, but I'd blow the devil out of Margie all day.
